'''Tel Terlou''' was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in [[Division Three]] of the [[Imperial Taxation Bureau]]. Terlou led a security briefing regarding [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and [[Black market/Legends|black market]] operations at [[Estaria Central Starport]].<ref name="HS" />
